title: New graduate student Ms. Aomsin and internee Ms. Tatar accepted in our lab
body: Ms. Aomsin's research field is yet to decide, while Ms. Tatar will work with Mr. Saurabh.

title: Three Students Graduate from CCC Lab
body: This year, three of our dedicated students successfully completed their degrees. We are incredibly proud of their hard work in the lab and wish them the absolute best in their future careers.
